settings.heading: Terms & Conditions
settings.body: Practical draft outline. Complete and obtain legal review for the countries where REÚ sells before launch.

settings.content:
Required sections to complete:

  • Acceptance and store eligibility
  • Product information and correction of errors
  • Supplement and medical disclaimer
  • Pre-orders, payment authorization, estimated shipment, delay, cancellation, and refunds
  • Pricing, taxes, promotions, countdown timers, and discount conditions
  • Orders, refusal/cancellation, fraud review, and quantity limits
  • Shipping, title/risk where applicable, and incorrect addresses
  • Returns and refunds
  • Intellectual property
  • User content and reviews
  • Prohibited uses
  • Third-party tools and links
  • Disclaimers and limitation of liability subject to local law
  • Indemnity where lawful
  • Governing law, dispute process, and severability
  • Changes and contact information

settings.heading: Supplement disclaimer
settings.content: Information on this website is provided for general educational purposes and is not medical advice. REÚ products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Individual needs and responses vary. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before using a supplement if you are pregnant or nursing, taking medication, have a medical condition, have allergies, or are unsure whether a product is suitable for you. Always follow the product label.
